title: The Quiet Cover
author: Rafael Brightwater
blurb: Casper Whitlock, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent twelve years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
